summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 14 May 2026 notifying the SEC of PDMR share transactions under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing discloses the grant and vesting of Sharing in Success awards under the 2024 Employee Share Plan, as well as delivery of shares for fixed share allowances. It includes details of shares vested, withheld for tax, and retained by each PDMR, with market prices used (5.7016 for grant, 5.7118 for tax). No special-situation corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is involved; it is a routine equity compensation disclosure.
